p=pathlib.Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1790689779/attempts/75b9ca6211d4403aafd75899a9af5d34/system/state/workspace/programs/task-c1cc60fd.py'); p.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True); p.write_text('''def transform(grid):
    # The marked cells define a shape. Paint every translated occurrence of
    # that shape whose underlying cells are all zero.
    g = [row[:] for row in grid]
    marker = next(v for row in g for v in row if v not in (0, 1, 2, 5, 8))
    pts = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(g) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == marker]
    r0 = min(r for r, c in pts)
    c0 = min(c for r, c in pts)
    shape = [(r-r0, c-c0) for r, c in pts]
    h, w = len(g), len(g[0])
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if all(r+dr < h and c+dc < w and g[r+dr][c+dc] == 0 for dr, dc in shape):
                for dr, dc in shape:
                    g[r+dr][c+dc] = marker
    return g
'''); print(p.read_text())
